description: MAX_BY(value, sort_key) / MIN_BY(value, sort_key) return the value from the row with the maximum or minimum key, ignoring NULL keys, with the FIRST-encountered row winning a tie (live-verified). All-NULL keys yield NULL. The bounded three-argument form returns an ARRAY of up to N values - ascending by key for MIN_BY, descending for MAX_BY - and accepts DISTINCT to dedup the values, which is the software-aggregation idiom. Converted 1:1 from functions/MaxByMinByTest (now retired); its @BeforeEach fixture is inlined per test and the ARRAY results are read through TO_JSON so the assertion lands on a VARCHAR no transport reformats.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE s (g INTEGER, name VARCHAR, score INTEGER)
SELECT g, MAX_BY(name, score), MIN_BY(name, score) FROM s GROUP BY g ORDER BY g
CREATE TABLE tie (name VARCHAR, score INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE nk (name VARCHAR, score INTEGER)
INSERT INTO nk VALUES ('a', NULL),('b', NULL)
CREATE TABLE cp (g INTEGER, ref VARCHAR)
SELECT TO_JSON(MIN_BY(ref, ref, 2)), TO_JSON(MAX_BY(ref, ref, 100)) FROM cp GROUP BY g
CREATE TABLE cpd (g INTEGER, ref VARCHAR)
SELECT TO_JSON(MIN_BY(DISTINCT ref, ref, 100)) FROM cpd GROUP BY g
